description: A sprite sheet of FOUR separate ancient forest shrine props arranged in a 2 by 2 grid, each centered in its own quarter: top-left a large ancient seal stone monolith with glowing red runes and dark cracks; top-right a broken mossy stone pillar; bottom-left a small carved rune stone with faint blue glow; bottom-right an old stone lantern covered in moss, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate with empty transparent space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette, front-facing view. Do not draw this house or tree.
